issues.issue: Does the Court of Appeal have jurisdiction to hear an appeal from an interlocutory Federal Court order in this immigration matter?
issues.result_quote: In my view, the case at bar exemplifies this second exception.

issues.issue: Did the Federal Court exceed its jurisdiction or err by raising on its own motion an unpleaded s. 15 Charter gender-pronoun issue and granting an interim stay on it?
issues.applicant_position: Minister: seeks to quash the order; the judge raised a new Charter issue with no pleadings, evidence or record.
issues.respondent_position: Ewen: the judge was managing the proceeding to treat him fairly and equally as a self-represented litigant.
issues.result_quote: The Federal Court exceeded its jurisdiction by unilaterally raising a new Charter issue that did not stem from the issues as framed by the parties

issues.issue: Should the stay motion be referred back to the Federal Court for decision?
issues.applicant_position: Minister: the stay motion is moot after the removal was cancelled and should not proceed.
issues.result_quote: I would not refer the underlying stay motion back to the Federal Court, as this would serve no useful purpose.
